style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

highlighted.semanticInvariant: Keep subtle geometric breathing and phase schedule with seamless native key13 closure; do not replace with a shader flash, locomotion or new sway.

clearance.trajectory: Source each part moves0.7*t outward along normalized localXY when nonzero, lofts sin(pi*t)*(0.2+0.04*sourcePartIndex), spinsZ by1.7*t*(sourcePartIndex%3-1), uniformly shrinks1-0.9*t. Meshes authored with origin0 do not acquire invented radial travel.
clearance.semanticInvariant: Start exactly idle, spread/loft/spin/shrink in original phase order and timing, retaining body/roof/hood/wheel/window/rubbish role motion. Do not replace geometry with opacity fade or hide finalframe.
clearance.partCountFreedom: Preserve semantic component trajectories through native action owners or a documented equivalent mapping. Original56meshes/168actions are audit facts, not target counts. New details must travel with appropriate component; removed/rebuilt parts need mapping evidence rather than keeping weak geometry.

rankedCriteria.outcome: A single coherent discarded car assembly with substantial rounded body/fenders/roof, convincing wheels and purposeful broken-window/cabin construction; avoid a stack of flat rectangles.
rankedCriteria.evidence: Four registered idle views enlarged and at128/55px per cell, target comparison and human-scale contexts. E/W must gain coherent structure too, not just the target-facing S.
rankedCriteria.failure: Only bevel/color adjustments while major source slabs remain visually weak; decorative details hide structural defects; changed scale to imitate target.

rankedCriteria.outcome: Soft panel gradients, restrained warm highlights and readable dark forms. Similar surfaces keep comparable treatment through rotations without preferred horizontal key direction.
rankedCriteria.evidence: Four facings on light/gray/dark backgrounds and repeated scene at logical/phone size.
rankedCriteria.failure: Black dead tires/undercarriage, harsh normals, clipped white highlights, persistent directional ground shadow or a side of the model lit with a different palette.

rankedCriteria.outcome: Pale/muted blue-gray paint remains dominant; localized warm rust/chips, gray metal trim, charcoal rubber and jagged blue glass distinguish materials and explain damage. Details are crafted and sparse enough to read at use size.
rankedCriteria.evidence: Target/native comparison plus all clips and four facings at use size.
rankedCriteria.failure: Uniform glossy plastic, photo-noise rust, orange takeover, texture swimming or tiny random marks that add noise without readable construction.

rankedCriteria.outcome: Highlighted breathes subtly with source phase/loop behavior; clearance visibly disassembles/spreads, lofts and shrinks according to original timing. Native new construction stays coherent at all phases without unintended intersections, culling, stretching or loose detached decorations in idle.
rankedCriteria.evidence: All100 native phase PNGs, original-layout atlases, native action audit,12fps playback for all8 moving view/clip combinations, loop closure diagnostics and post-clearance floor reveal.
rankedCriteria.failure: Substitute flashing tint/fade/wobble, silent all-transparent finalframe, missing poses, loop jump, clipped flight envelope or geometry/material defects hidden by single idle view.

rankedCriteria.outcome: Transparent sprite edges are clean, contact reads naturally and complete car fits declared placement. Intentional cabin holes remain legible; no accidental seams, pinholes, coplanar flicker, deep black overlap scars, halos or baked floor/shadow.

rankedCriteria.failure: Target card/paint-over, frame fitting/cropping, undocumented native dependency, foreground part clipping or placement failure.
